symbols.phrase: Look here, a swallow with outstretched wings—it brings distant winds and sudden news.
A jagged peak rises; the climb looks steep, but the high view reveals tomorrow.
An archway stands open to the sky; an invitation calls you past your threshold.
This pale serpentine line is an old road, carrying your boots into unfamiliar soil.
Resting beside the grounds, a heavy iron key whispers that quiet doors will yield.
A curved vessel rests in the sediment, carrying your hopes across wide water safely.

conclusion: The sediment never lies when the heart is already packing its bags, my child. The swallow has whistled to the winds, and this long winding path asks only that you trust the strength of your own feet. You may fear the steep mountain rising before you, but the cup shows you carry both the vessel to cross deep waters and the key to unlock the gate on the other side. Do not cling to tired walls out of habit when life is unrolling such a wide world before you. Leave your doubts at the bottom of the cup, take a deep breath of the mountain air, and walk forth with a quiet heart.
